meaning.meaning_en: This meme uses the image of Peter Parker putting on his glasses to represent a sudden, dramatic shift in perspective or a change in self-image. The top text usually describes a positive or confident state, while the bottom text reveals a harsh, often self-deprecating reality or a sudden realization of a negative truth.
